answer: Proof of Stake serves as a digital haven where Sybil resistance is enforced via capital commitment. To prevent a lagoon of malicious nodes from flooding the network, each agent must stake tokens, effectively transforming the lotus of trust into a verifiable economic bond. The cost of a Sybil attack becomes prohibitively expensive, as an adversary must acquire the majority of the circulating supply to compromise consensus, ensuring that identities remain strictly tied to real financial risk.
